prose: NVIDIA and Microsoft held a Windows and Surface event on agents for PCs. Jensen Huang and Satya Nadella spoke in a fireside chat, and Huang said that in the agent era the PC becomes a personal assistant.

Microsoft announced general availability of Microsoft Execution Containers, OS-level infrastructure meant to make Windows a secure platform for agents, alongside the RTX Spark hardware push. The page is NVIDIA's own event write-up; details beyond the excerpt were not reviewed.
highlights: Windows event on agents with RTX Spark hardware
Microsoft Execution Containers now generally available
Aim: a secure platform for agents on Windows
